svg.title: Different surface returns occur on both sides of a mapped footprint
svg.desc: A single plan of unique points. Purple roof, green vegetation and grey ground returns occur inside and outside a dashed mapped footprint. Red rings mark selected non-roof returns inside. The border falls between samples; points are not clipped to fit it.
svg.text: Surface returns occur on both sides of the mapped edge
Illustrative plan · each point appears once · colours identify surfaces in this example
The polygon selects locations; it does not establish which surface produced a return.
An exact crop excludes exterior points but can retain non-roof returns already inside the boundary.
